victim_self_allowance_sufficient.meaning: victim user has set a self-allowance allowance[user][user] on the ShareToken sufficient for the withdrawal

attacker_kyc_verified.meaning: attacker (Bob) is KYC verified in the ShareToken's KYC registry

receiver_kyc_verified.meaning: receiver of the underlying assets is KYC verified in the ShareToken's KYC registry
receiver_kyc_verified.checkpoint: at receipt of underlying assets from the vault

underlying_assets_received.meaning: receiver receives the underlying assets from the vault

assumptions: The attacker (Bob) is the receiver of the underlying assets in the reported scenario.
The withdrawal is executed via the vault's withdraw with owner set to the victim user.
limitations: The KYC-verified status of the receiver is represented as a report-grounded Boolean; concrete registry lookup logic is deferred to code binding.
The self-allowance sufficiency is represented as a report-grounded Boolean; the exact allowance amount is not stated.
